userId.description: Stable user id, the only safe way to identify this player

spotifyUserId.description: Spotify user ID, present only when the account is linked

hasLinkedAccount.description: Whether any credential is attached. False means an anonymous player, who has nothing to log out of.

hasAccount.description: Whether this player has any credential at all, Spotify or email. False means an anonymous player whose progress lives on this device.

email.description: Email of the account, when it was created with one

emailVerified.description: Whether the address has been proved. False on an account with no email at all, and on one whose address is only claimed.

avatarUrl.description: Effective avatar URL for display (resolves to custom or Spotify)

customAvatarUrl.description: Cloudinary URL of the custom avatar, if uploaded

spotifyAvatarUrl.description: Spotify avatar URL from the user profile

avatarSource.description: Which avatar source is currently active

country.description: The country of the user, as set in the user's account profile. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

email.description: Email address to sign up with

token.description: The token from the link in the email

verified.description: Whether the link was live. False covers wrong, expired and already used alike: all three mean the same thing to whoever is holding it.

email.description: The address to send a reset link to

token.description: The token from the link in the email

reset.description: Whether the link was live. False covers wrong, expired and already used alike.

imageUrl.description: The image URL of the playlist

totalTracks.description: The total number of tracks in the playlist

externalUrl.description: The external URL of the playlist

playlistId.description: The ID of the playlist to start the game with

trackGroupId.description: A curated group to draw from, for a player with no library of their own. Takes precedence over playlistId.

mode.description: The game mode to start (all or daily)

trackUrl.description: Link to the track in the catalogue it came from

isrc.description: ISRC of the recording, used to judge the guess

albumImageUrl.description: The album image URL of the track

albumName.description: The album name of the track

albumUrl.description: The album URL of the track

releaseYear.description: The release year of the track

round.description: The round this hint was revealed

sessionId.description: The ID of the game session

currentRound.description: The current round of the game

snippetDuration.description: The duration of the current snippet

maxRounds.description: The maximum number of rounds in the game

snippetSteps.description: Snippet length for every round, so the client can show what each miss unlocks

previewUrl.description: The preview URL of the current track

answer.description: The answer to the current track

albumImageUrl.description: Album art URL, exposed progressively during gameplay

rankTitle.description: Optional personalized rank title (easter egg for special users)

specialNote.description: Optional personalized note (easter egg for special users)

hints.description: Progressive song metadata hints for the current round

score.description: Score 0-6, may be null if abandoned

totalItems.description: Total number of items across all pages

itemCount.description: Number of items on the current page

streakFreezeUsages.description: Streak freeze usages within the date range (only for DAILY mode)

best.description: The longest this tally has ever been

playedToday.description: Whether the user has played today's daily

attempts.description: Guesses used, or MAX_ROUNDS on a loss

gameNumber.description: Game number (days since epoch or similar)

trackId.description: The ID of the track to guess

skip.description: Whether the current guess is a skip

currentRound.description: The current round of the game

snippetDuration.description: The duration of the current snippet

hints.description: Progressive song metadata hints for the next round

showAlbumHint.description: Show progressively blurred album art hint

showTextHints.description: Show genre, decade, and other text hints

showStatsToOthers.description: Show this player by name on public leaderboards. Off by default: a player ranks anonymously until they choose to be named.

showAlbumHint.description: Show progressively blurred album art hint

showTextHints.description: Show genre, decade, and other text hints

showStatsToOthers.description: Show this player by name on public leaderboards

question.description: The next question, or null if no more questions available

done.description: Whether there are no more questions to answer

capacity.description: Seats in the room, so the list can read 3/20

trackSource.description: Whether it draws on the curated pool or on linked libraries

roundCount.description: Number of rounds for the game

score.description: Best score achieved in the period
